description: Fetch the real GitHub trending repositories from github.com/trending. since=daily (default) | weekly | monthly switches the period tab (今日/本周/本月); language filters by primary programming language via the /trending/<language> URL (e.g. python, javascript, rust). Returns ranked cards with full_name, description, language, total stars, stars gained in the period, forks, builders, and URL. Reads GitHub's actual trending ranking, unlike the previous Search-API approximation. No login required.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Trending period: daily (default, 今日) | weekly (本周) | monthly (本月). Maps to the since tabs on github.com/trending.（榜单周期 tab，对应 trending 页顶部 daily/weekly/monthly 切换。）

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Filter by primary programming language, e.g. python, javascript, rust, c++. Corresponds to the /trending/<language> URL path.（按编程语言过滤，对应 trending 页的语言下拉，映射到 /trending/<language> 路径。）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum repositories to return (1-25, default 20). The trending page is a ranked list whose length varies by period/language (about 12-24 repos); limit truncates it and the response reports available (true page count).（条数上限；trending 页条数随周期/语言变化，limit 只做截断，available 字段返回页面真实条数。）
